census_geocoder: Coordinates from the US Census Geocoder batch on the CMS address (US Government work); coordinates_confidence carries the match quality.
cfld_null_outside_layer: CFLD_EXPP null means the tract is outside NRI's coastal-flood layer: cfld_expp_clean = 0, status imputed. The source column is unchanged.
cfld_share: Share of tract population in NRI's coastal-flood layer: cfld_expp_clean / POPULATION, capped at 1.
cms_dialysis_stations: Dialysis centers and stations summed from the CMS Dialysis Facility listing, county from ZIP; a county with no listed center is 0, status imputed.
cms_join_ccn: Joined to CMS Nursing Home Provider Information on CMS Certification Number (CCN).
cms_occupancy: Occupancy = CMS Average Number of Residents per Day / CMS certified beds (an average, not the daily census).
coordinates_absent: CMS publishes no coordinates and the geocoder found no match.
dialysis_patients_per_station: Live emPOWER dialysis beneficiaries / CMS stations; null where a county has no station.
empower_live_canonical: HHS emPOWER REST service, fetched 2026-10-27; canonical for power dependence and dialysis.
empower_snapshot_unverified: Snapshot column facility_esrd_dialysis_any_dme (6,009 statewide) does not match the live service's dialysis count (18,026); kept as published, marked suspect, never used as dialysis patients.
empower_suppressed_1_11: emPOWER shows counts of 1-10 as 11: the value is the range 1-11, _low = 1, value kept as upper bound.
fips_from_geo_id: County FIPS = first five digits of the 2020 tract geo_id.
gamap2care_facility: GaMap2Care facility record as published by Georgia DCH, facility fields only.
gema_contraflow_point: GEMA I-16 contraflow intersection as published.
gema_zone: GEMA hurricane evacuation zone (County, Zone) whose polygon contains the point (tract centroid for tracts). Null with status external: outside every zone; GEMA zones cover 11 coastal counties. Where edge slivers overlap, the earliest zone letter wins. Null with status unrecorded: no point.
hrcn_ealp_percentile: Canonical hurricane exposure: percent rank (0-1) of NRI HRCN_EALP, expected annual population loss, among Georgia hazard rows. HRCN_AFREQ stays as published.
medical_shelter_distance_pending: Straight-line km to the nearest snapshot shelter with is_medical = true, read-only from the raw snapshot: pending teammate shelters_clean.
ncei_storm_aggregate: Per storm and state: NCEI Storm Events counts and sums as reported (counties from county-type rows only; forecast-zone rows carry no county).
ncei_storm_match_narrative: NCEI event matched to a HURDAT2 storm by the storm name in its narrative and active dates.
ncei_storm_match_nearest: NCEI event assigned to the nearest active HURDAT2 storm (no name in the narrative).
nearest_tract_centroid: Assigned to the tract whose 2020 centroid is nearest (straight line, UTM 17N).
nullif_trim: Blank or whitespace-only strings are null (unrecorded), never a value.
overture_places: Overture Maps Places release 2026-10-21.0, per-row licence in source_license (CDLA-Permissive-2.0, Apache-2.0, CC0-1.0); confidence is Overture's own. A listing, not licensure: no beds, no fleet size.
small_home_aggregated: Personal care home with 6 or fewer licensed beds, often a family home in a private residence: NAME and ADDRESS are null and Latitude/Longitude are its tract centroid in every output; beds and counts stay. Distances and evacuation zone use the tract centroid.
source_value: Value as published by the source; no transformation.
tract_hazard_join: Hazard value of the facility's nearest tract (hazard_tracts clean columns).
vulnerability_tract_join: True when the hazard row's geo_id is in the snapshot vulnerability_tracts table.
webeoc_facility_fields: GEMA WebEOC shelter feed restricted to facility and status fields; contact names, phones, fax, remarks, subscriber and editor fields are never read.
zip_to_county_empower: County from the facility ZIP via the emPOWER ZIP table's county FIPS (one county per ZIP).
